name: vi-history-suite
description: VS Code extension for content-detected LabVIEW VI history review in Git repositories.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: VI History disables selected-file history evaluation and comparison execution in untrusted workspaces to prevent external process execution. Documentation and local runtime settings CLI preparation remain available.

viHistorySuite.strictRsrcHeader.description: When enabled, require the leading RSRC CRLF bytes in addition to LVIN/LVCC at offset 8.

viHistorySuite.historyWindowMode.description: How the VI History panel chooses its retained commit window. Auto loads the full file history when it fits within the automatic safety ceiling; capped uses the explicit maxHistoryEntries limit.

viHistorySuite.maxHistoryEntries.description: Explicit retained-commit ceiling when historyWindowMode is capped.

viHistorySuite.runtimeProvider.description: Installed-user compare provider request. Host is the default local LabVIEWCLI path; docker is a bounded expert path selected through the generated settings CLI.

viHistorySuite.labviewVersion.description: Installed-user LabVIEW major version for comparison reports. Use LabVIEW 2025, 2026, or a newer local version; LabVIEW 2025 and newer can open older VIs without migrating them before generating the report.

viHistorySuite.labviewBitness.description: Installed-user LabVIEW bitness for comparison reports.

viHistorySuite.labviewExePath.description: Optional override for the host LabVIEW executable used for comparison reports. Set this to the exact LabVIEW.exe (Windows) or labview (Linux) when your install is at a location auto-detection does not cover. The comparison runtime validates the path and reports a missing-path error if it does not exist. Restricted in untrusted workspaces because it names an executable the comparison launches.

viHistorySuite.labviewCliPath.description: Optional override for the LabVIEWCLI executable used for comparison reports. Set this to the exact LabVIEWCLI(.exe) when your install is at a location auto-detection does not cover; this also lets VI History open when the LabVIEW CLI prerequisite gate would otherwise block. The comparison runtime validates the path and reports a missing-path error if it does not exist. Restricted in untrusted workspaces because it names an executable the comparison launches.

viHistorySuite.container.imageVersion.description: VHS-REQ-650: selected LabVIEW Docker image version for the container comparison providers, as a canonical tag such as 2026q1-windows, 2026q1patch2-windows, or 2026q1-linux. Leave empty to use the newest supported default. Use the 'Pick LabVIEW Container Image Version' command to choose from versions discovered on Docker Hub and already pulled locally; new National Instruments patches and release years become selectable without updating the extension. Restricted in untrusted workspaces because it names the image the comparison launches.

viHistorySuite.runtime.cliConnectTimeout.description: VHS-REQ-148: LabVIEW CLI connect-window timeout (in seconds) written into LabVIEWCLI.ini before each Windows host-native compare. Sets OpenAppReferenceTimeoutInSecond and AfterLaunchOpenAppReferenceTimeoutInSecond. Default 180 matches the shipped Windows-container value; lower it only on hosts with confirmed sub-30s LabVIEW cold launches.

viHistorySuite.report.ignoreViAttributes.description: VHS-REQ-645: exclude VI attribute differences from comparison reports (LabVIEWCLI CreateComparisonReport -noattr).

viHistorySuite.report.ignoreFrontPanel.description: VHS-REQ-645: exclude all front panel differences from comparison reports (LabVIEWCLI CreateComparisonReport -nofp).

viHistorySuite.report.ignoreFrontPanelOb.description: VHS-REQ-645: exclude front panel object size and position differences from comparison reports (LabVIEWCLI CreateComparisonReport -nofppos).

viHistorySuite.report.ignoreBlockDiagram.description: VHS-REQ-645: exclude all block diagram differences from comparison reports (LabVIEWCLI CreateComparisonReport -nobd).
VHS-REQ-645: exclude block diagram cosmetic differences, including object position and size, from comparison reports (LabVIEWCLI CreateComparisonReport -nobdcosm).

scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run test:integration:compile && node out-tests/tests/integration/runTests.js
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run package:audit && node scripts/runPinnedVsce.js package
